description: Seen-problem / utterance-disjoint. The shipped test.jsonl: new utterances about problems that also appear in train.jsonl and val.jsonl. This is the condition behind the previously reported 0.8457 / 0.8373.
Problem-disjoint. Every llama3.1:8b utterance whose problem is one of the 10 held-out test problems. No test problem, paraphrase, persona rendering or generator variant appears in train or val.
Supplementary. The same llama3.1:8b pool restricted to the 30 TRAIN problems. Holding the utterance pool constant, the gap to B_problem_disjoint isolates the seen-problem effect.
Supplementary. The same llama3.1:8b pool restricted to the 10 VALIDATION problems. Reported for completeness; nothing was tuned on it.
